name: adops-mcp
description: CSV-first analytics and optimization for Google Ads + Meta Ads. Import CSV exports from your ad dashboards (no OAuth, no developer tokens), then run unified cross-platform reporting, budget optimization, anomaly detection, A/B testing, spend forecasting, and industry benchmarks. Export recommendations as Google Ads Editor or Meta Ads Manager bulk-edit CSVs. 17 tools, 4 resources, 3 prompts.

tools.name: ad_demo_seed
tools.description: Seed realistic cross-platform demo portfolio (8 campaigns, 30 days metrics) for evaluation

tools.name: ad_csv_import
tools.description: Import Google Ads Editor or Meta Ads Manager CSV export — every other tool operates on this data

tools.name: ads_export_recommendations
tools.description: Export budget_analyze recommendations as Google Ads Editor CSV, Meta Ads Manager CSV, JSON, or Markdown — one bulk-paste action

tools.name: platform_connect
tools.description: Register a platform connection manually (alternative to CSV import)

tools.name: campaign_list
tools.description: List and filter campaigns across all imported platforms

tools.name: campaign_create
tools.description: Add a campaign for what-if planning

tools.name: campaign_update
tools.description: Update local campaign settings (budget, status, bidding, schedule)

tools.name: ads_report
tools.description: Unified cross-platform performance report (CTR, CPC, CPM, ROAS, CPA)

tools.name: budget_analyze
tools.description: Budget allocation analysis with AI-generated scaling/pausing/reallocation recommendations

tools.name: budget_reallocate
tools.description: Transfer budget between campaigns across platforms

tools.name: creative_specs
tools.description: Platform-specific image, video, text requirements reference

tools.name: anomaly_detect
tools.description: Statistical anomaly detection (CPC spikes, CTR drops, spend surges)

tools.name: ab_test_analyze
tools.description: A/B test comparison with statistical significance scoring

tools.name: forecast_spend
tools.description: Spend, conversion, ROAS forecasting for 7/14/30 days

resources.description: All active campaigns with key metrics
